fields.summary_ko.0: AAPL experienced significant service outages on Tuesday affecting iCloud, App Store, and Apple Music, causing login and payment difficulties for users, with the stock declining less than 1%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Major companies including Microsoft (MSFT), JPMorgan Chase (JPM), and United Airlines (UAL) experienced cascading system outages last week, all traced to technical failures rather than cyber attacks.
